n4d2e11efaed.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about 5G network slicing?
o: It splits one physical network into several virtual networks
It is achieved by means of SDN/NFV
It merges several virtual networks into one physical network
It is a feature of 5G networks
n4d2e11efaed.x: Slicing splits one physical network into several virtual networks using SDN/NFV; it does not merge virtual networks into one.

n1d81ff3d9bb.s: What is the effect of e-governance on transparency in government work?
o: It removes the need for transparency
n1d81ff3d9bb.x: E-governance lowers the cost of government, increases citizen input and improves transparency; 'reduced transparency' is a common trap.

nb67d4f4edc9.s: Which of the following pairs (India Stack layer – platform) is correctly matched?
nb67d4f4edc9.x: The data layer of India Stack is DEPA / Account Aggregator (consent-based); identity is Aadhaar and payments is UPI.

nd53102281b7.s:
Consider the following statements about SWAYAM:
1. It offers free MOOCs for higher education, including courses from IITs and IIMs.
2. NPTEL is a national coordinator of DIKSHA.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nd53102281b7.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: NPTEL is a national coordinator of SWAYAM, not DIKSHA.

n6a037633ee4.s: 'Information for All' is which pillar of Digital India?
n6a037633ee4.x: Information for All is pillar 6; Broadband Highways is pillar 1 and e-Kranti pillar 5.

n955f5d262f0.s: Under the National Policy on IT, 2012, the IT exports target for 2020 was:
n955f5d262f0.x: The IT exports target was US$200 billion; US$300 billion was the IT-ITES revenue target.

nf23813d63c5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Global Capability Centres (GCCs)?
o: They are offshore units operated by multinational corporations
They perform functions for their own parent MNC
Outsourcing vendors, unlike GCCs, serve other organisations
They are the same as outsourcing vendors serving unrelated companies
nf23813d63c5.x: GCCs serve their parent MNCs, whereas outsourcing vendors serve other organisations, so they are not the same.

n74f24c662f1.s:
Consider the following statements about support under Semicon 2.0:
1. CMOS silicon fabs get up to 40% capital subsidy.
2. Advanced packaging gets up to 75% of project cost.
3. R&D gets up to 75% of project cost.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
n74f24c662f1.x: CMOS fabs get up to 40% and R&D up to 75% of project cost; advanced packaging gets 35%, so statement 2 is wrong.

new.s: Which futurist is associated with the idea of the 'Third Wave'?
new.x: Alvin Toffler gave the 'Third Wave'; Klaus Schwab coined 'Fourth Industrial Revolution' in 2016.

new.s: In 5G technology, 'NR' in 5G NR stands for:
new.x: 5G NR is 5G New Radio, the air-interface standard.

new.s: Near-Field Communication (NFC) works over a distance of about:
new.x: NFC works only within a few centimetres.

new.s: Web 3.0 refers to:
new.x: Web 3.0 is the decentralised, blockchain-based internet.

new.s: Precision farming and soil monitoring are IoT uses in:
new.x: Precision farming, soil monitoring, livestock and yields are smart-agriculture uses of IoT.

new.s: The correct order of the three IoT layers, from the physical level up, is:
new.x: Sensors in the perception layer collect data, the network layer transmits it and the application layer gives user services.

new.s: Fitness trackers and health monitors are examples of which IoT category?
new.x: Fitness trackers and health monitors are wearable IoT devices.

new.s: The AI chatbot 'Krutrim' was developed by:
new.x: Krutrim was unveiled by Ola (Bhavish Aggarwal) on 15 Dec 2023.

new.s: The Indian-language generative AI platform 'Hanooman' (May 2024) was developed by:
new.x: Hanooman is by SML India with 3AI Holding; Krutrim is Ola's and ChatGPT is OpenAI's.

new.s: Which company partnered ICRISAT and the AP government in the 2016 AI Sowing App pilot?
new.x: The AI Sowing App was a Microsoft + ICRISAT + AP government pilot.

new.s: The 2016 AI Sowing App pilot in Devanakonda mandal, Kurnool, advised farmers growing:
new.x: It gave Telugu SMS advice on sowing dates for groundnut.

new.s: ChatGPT, developed by OpenAI, was launched on:
new.x: ChatGPT was launched on 30 Nov 2022; 15 Dec 2023 is Krutrim and May 2024 Hanooman.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about blockchain:
1. It is a decentralised distributed ledger.
2. Its records are immutable.
3. Its records are controlled by a single central authority.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Blockchain is a decentralised, immutable distributed ledger; it is not controlled by a single central authority.

new.s: Unique digital assets recorded as tokens on a blockchain are called:
new.x: NFTs are unique digital assets; real-world asset tokens represent land, bonds and similar assets.

new.s: Land records, pharma supply chains and e-Notary (e-Sign) are governance uses of:
new.x: These are listed governance uses of blockchain.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about RFID tags:
1. Active RFID tags have their own battery.
2. Passive RFID tags have a longer range than active tags.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Active tags have their own battery and longer range; passive tags use the reader's signal and have a shorter range.

new.s: NAFRS (National Automated Facial Recognition System) is being developed by:
new.x: NAFRS is by NCRB; I4C runs NCAP.

new.s: The original three Vs of big data (2001) are:
new.x: Volume, Velocity and Variety were the original 3 Vs; Veracity and Value were added later.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (big data V – meaning) is wrongly matched?
o: Velocity – speed of generation and analysis
Variety – structured, semi-structured and unstructured data
new.x: Veracity means quality, accuracy and trustworthiness; usefulness is Value.

new.s: In cloud computing, SaaS provides:
new.x: SaaS is Software as a Service: ready-to-use software; IaaS gives infrastructure and PaaS a platform.

new.s: MeghRaj, the Government of India cloud initiative of MeitY, is also known as:
new.x: MeghRaj is the GI Cloud of MeitY, not a 5G or telecom project.

new.s: The national cloud under MeghRaj was launched by NIC in:
new.x: NIC launched the national cloud under MeghRaj in 2014.

new.s: Which of the following is a deployment model used in MeitY's cloud empanelment?
new.x: MeitY empanels Public, Virtual Private and Government Community Cloud; IaaS, PaaS and SaaS are service models.

new.s: In the indigenous Bharat Telecom Stack, the core network was built by:
new.x: C-DOT built the core, Tejas Networks the radio and TCS did integration; BSNL deploys it.

new.s: 6G networks are expected to arrive in the:
new.x: 6G is expected in the early 2030s.

new.s: The Bharat Telecom Stack was launched by the Prime Minister on:
new.x: The indigenous stack was launched on 27 Sep 2025 (4G, 5G-ready).

new.s: The MCA portal and GSTN are examples of which e-governance model?
new.x: MCA portal and GSTN are G2B; NIC solutions for departments are G2G.

new.s: The last phase in Gartner's four-phase model of e-governance is:
new.x: The phases are Information, Interaction, Transaction and Transformation.

new.s: Which body is the SPV and implementing agency of Common Service Centres?
new.x: CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd is the SPV for CSCs.

new.s: e-Taal, the dashboard of e-transaction statistics, was built by:
new.x: NIC built e-Taal.

new.s: When approved in 2006, NeGP had:
new.x: NeGP began with 27 MMPs and 10 components; it later grew to 31 MMPs.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (MMP – category) is correctly matched?
new.x: Income Tax is a Central MMP; e-Biz and eCourts are Integrated and CCTNS is a State MMP.

new.s: The MCA21 Mission Mode Project is under the Ministry of:
new.x: MCA21 (online company filing) is under Corporate Affairs; Passport Seva is MEA.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the eCourts Mission Mode Project:
1. It has been in place since 2007.
2. Its Phase III covers 2023–27.
3. It is a State Mission Mode Project.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: eCourts began in 2007 and Phase III is 2023–27; it is an Integrated MMP, not a State one.

new.s: Which mission, launched on 25 Sep 2014, focuses on manufacturing and investment?
new.x: Make in India (25 Sep 2014) is about manufacturing and investment.

new.s: Skill India was launched on:
new.x: Skill India was launched on 15 Jul 2015; Digital India on 1 Jul 2015.

new.s: As of April 2025, the number of Common Service Centres under the Public Internet Access Programme was about:
new.x: There were 5.97 lakh CSCs, of which 4.73 lakh were at GP level.

new.s: How many Mission Mode Projects are there under e-Kranti?
new.x: e-Kranti has 44 MMPs, up from NeGP's 27 and later 31.

new.s: 'Transforming e-Governance for Transforming Governance' is the vision of:
new.x: It is the vision of e-Kranti (NeGP 2.0), approved in 2015.

new.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order:
1. ONDC
2. MyGov
3. Aadhaar
4. PM eVIDYA
new.x: Aadhaar (2009), MyGov (2014), PM eVIDYA (2020), ONDC (2022) – the APPSC 2024 chronology.

new.s: DigiLocker was launched in:
new.x: DigiLocker was launched in Feb 2015; MyGov in Jul 2014.

new.s: Tembhli, the first Aadhaar village (29 Sep 2010), is in which state?
new.x: Tembhli is in Nandurbar district, Maharashtra.

new.s: An Aadhaar number issued by UIDAI has how many digits?
new.x: Aadhaar is a 12-digit number.

new.s: QR-coded textbooks and teacher training for school education are features of:
new.x: DIKSHA is the school e-content platform; SWAYAM is for higher education.

new.s: BhashaNet is the Universal Acceptance portal of:
new.x: BhashaNet was launched by NIXI and MeitY on 21 Mar 2024.

new.s: India's rank in the UN E-Government Development Index 2024 was:
new.x: India was 97th in UN EGDI 2024, up from 105th in 2022.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about e-governance indices?
new.x: India was 97th in UN EGDI 2024 and 105th in 2022.

new.s: AP Fibernet, offering IPTV, internet and telephone over GPON, was launched on:
new.x: AP Fibernet (APSFL) was launched on 27 Dec 2017.

new.s: By Aug 2026, UPI transaction volume had grown roughly how many times in 10 years?
new.x: UPI volume rose about 13,000-fold in 10 years.

new.s: The National Informatics Centre (NIC) was set up in:
new.x: NIC was set up in 1976; C-DAC came in 1988.

new.s: The National e-Governance Plan with Mission Mode Projects came in:
new.x: NeGP came in 2006; 1998 was the IT Task Force.

new.s: In 2011–12, about what share of the IT industry was concentrated in six hubs?
new.x: Six hubs had about 90% of the industry; about 80% of revenue came from exports.

new.s: NPIT 2012 aimed to spread the IT industry to:
o: Tier II and Tier III cities
new.x: NPIT 2012 sought to spread IT beyond the six hubs to Tier II and Tier III cities.

new.s: The NPIT 2012 target for skilled manpower by 2020 was:
new.x: NPIT 2012 targeted 10 million additional ICT workers.

new.s: The e-literacy target of NPIT 2012 was:
o: One e-literate person in every household
One e-literate person in every village
new.x: The target was at least one e-literate person per household.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NPIT 2012 targets?
o: They were to be met by 2025
IT-ITES revenue was to reach US$300 billion
IT exports were to reach US$200 billion
One e-literate person per household was a target
new.x: NPIT 2012 targets were for 2020; 2025 is the NPE 2019 deadline.

new.s: The NPE 2019 target for electronics manufacturing by 2025 is:
new.x: NPE 2019 targets US$400 billion; US$190 bn and US$110 bn are mobile manufacturing and exports.

new.s: The SPECS scheme under the National Policy on Electronics supports:
new.x: SPECS supports components and semiconductors; PLI is for large-scale electronics and EMC 2.0 for clusters.

new.s: EMC 2.0, notified on 1 April 2020, supports:
o: Electronics clusters and common facility centres
new.x: EMC 2.0 supports electronics manufacturing clusters and common facility centres.

new.s: Micron's ATMP semiconductor unit is located at:
new.x: Micron's ATMP is at Sanand; Tata's OSAT is at Jagiroad and RRP's unit in Sri Sathya Sai district.

new.s: The Chips to Start-up (C2S) programme aims to train how many students over five years?
new.x: C2S aims at 85,000 students; 1,00,000 engineers is the Semicon 2.0 talent target.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (institution – role) is correctly matched?
new.x: STPI runs export-oriented IT parks; NASSCOM is the industry association, C-DAC builds PARAM and NIELIT is a deemed university.

new.s: The government IT and e-governance network is run by:
new.x: NIC runs the government IT network, not STPI.

new.s: In India's export basket, electronics ranks as the:
new.x: Electronics is India's 3rd-largest export item.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Data Centre Policy targets capacity of up to:
new.x: The AP Data Centre Policy targets up to 1 GW.

new.s: Which company is setting up a campus in Visakhapatnam with about 7,000 jobs?
new.x: Infosys is building a Visakhapatnam campus of about 7,000 jobs.
